items.title: The derived Hom is computed by resolving and applying Hom in the dg category
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dga.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-hom-derived at source lines 2849-2867: under the standing hypotheses the right derived functor of Hom out of a complex K is computed by replacing the second variable by a suitable resolution and then taking morphisms in the dg category, so that the derived Hom exists and is given by that construction. The proof at source lines 2869-2892 uses the resolution results of the chapter to replace a complex by a quasi-isomorphic object with the required properties, verifies that the construction is independent of the resolution up to quasi-isomorphism using the homotopy-invariance statements, and then checks the two defining properties of a derived functor: that it extends the underived functor on the original category and that it is compatible with the homotopy category. The references it uses reach other chapters (the Homology and Derived chapters) and a Homology-chapter result is named by its project tag; those targets carry canonical tags and are declared as source pointers, while everything the counted argument needs is inside the retained spans.
